caseName: Local 553, International Brotherhood of Teamsters v. National Labor Relations Board
caseNameFull: Local 553, International Brotherhood of Teamsters, Chauffeurs, Warehousemen & Helpers of America, v. National Labor Relations Board
attorneys: Samuel J. Cohen for petitioner., Solicitor General Cox, Stuart Rothman, Dominick L. Manoli, Norton J. Come and Herman M. Levy for respondent.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The petition for writ of certiorari is granted and the judgment is vacated; The case is remanded to the United States Court of Appeals with instructions to remand to the National Labor Relations Board for consideration in light of Local 357, International Brotherhood of Teamsters, Chauffeurs, Warehousemen & Helpers of America, v. National Labor Relations Board, 365 U. S. 667.
